response.sql: WITH date_filtered AS (SELECT * FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'), grouped_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) as avg_hgb, AVG(CASE WHEN `T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL AND CRE != 0 THEN CAST(`T-BIL` AS FLOAT) / CAST(CRE AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio FROM date_filtered GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_mean_ratio FROM grouped_stats WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT gs.CENTROMEA, gs.avg_hgb, gs.avg_ratio, gs.avg_ratio / om.overall_mean_ratio as ratio_relative_to_mean FROM grouped_stats gs CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE om.overall_mean_ratio IS NOT NULL;
